name: Policy-as-Code Evaluation
description: Evaluation of policy-as-code frameworks for infrastructure security enforcement. Covers Open Policy Agent (OPA/Rego, including Gatekeeper and Conftest), Kyverno, HashiCorp Sentinel, AWS Service Control Policies, Azure Policy, and GCP Organization Policies. Includes policy rule effectiveness assessment, bypass testing, and coverage gap analysis.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands policy-as-code concepts and common frameworks
evidence: Can explain the purpose and architecture of policy-as-code in infrastructure security
Familiar with at least two frameworks (OPA, Sentinel, cloud-native policies)
Understands the difference between preventive and detective policy controls

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews policy rules and evaluates coverage under supervision
evidence: Reviews OPA/Rego or Sentinel policies against security requirements under guidance
Tests policy enforcement against known misconfiguration scenarios
Documents policy evaluation findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently evaluates policy-as-code effectiveness and identifies bypass paths
evidence: Independently assesses policy rule coverage against security baselines
Identifies policy bypass techniques through resource attribute manipulation
Evaluates policy enforcement points in CI/CD and deployment pipelines

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Develops policy rules and bypass tests; evaluates complex policy architectures; mentors others
evidence: Writes and reviews complex OPA/Rego and Sentinel policy rules
Develops systematic bypass testing methodologies for policy frameworks
Reviews policy evaluation work of junior analysts

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab policy evaluation methodology; publishes research on policy-as-code security
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's policy-as-code evaluation framework
Published research on policy bypass techniques or enforcement gaps
Recognized as authority on infrastructure policy enforcement

assessment_methods.description: Given a set of OPA/Sentinel policies, identify coverage gaps and demonstrate bypass techniques
Design a policy-as-code ruleset for a given security baseline and justify enforcement decisions
